nome_jp: 弾丸のリュウセイ・リボルバー
testo:
Double Breaker
■ When you put this creature, choose 6 cards from your mana zone and put the rest into your graveyard. Then your opponent chooses 6 cards from their mana zone and puts the rest into their graveyard.
■ Your opponent's cards are put into their mana zone tapped.
testo_jp:
Double Breaker
■ このクリーチャーが出た時、自分のマナゾーンからカードを６枚選び、残りを墓地に置く。その後、相手は自身のマナゾーンからカードを６枚選び、残りを墓地に置く。
■ 相手のカードは、タップしてマナゾーンに置く。
